rulebook_meta.name: Data Risk Register Review Criteria (PLACEHOLDER / FUTURE)
rulebook_meta.status: NOT USED IN THE POC — placeholder to show how a future review domain plugs in as DATA
rulebook_meta.note: When the data-risk domain is built, these criteria are what the data_risk_agent checks a project's risk register against. Wording is illustrative; the Solution Architect Office / risk owners will firm these up. Adding or editing criteria here is a DATA change, not a code change.

rules.statement: Every risk must be well-formed with a clear cause, event, and consequence.
rules.check_hint: Flag risk entries that state only a vague concern without cause/event/consequence.

rules.statement: Every risk must have an assigned owner and a target resolution date.
rules.check_hint: Flag risks with no named owner or no date.

rules.statement: Likelihood and impact scores must use the approved rating scale and be internally consistent.
rules.check_hint: Flag scores outside the approved scale or ratings that contradict the described consequence.

rules.statement: The register must cover the expected risk categories (delivery, vendor, dependency, data, security).
rules.check_hint: Flag obvious category gaps — e.g. a data-heavy project with no data risks recorded.

rules.statement: Every high or critical risk must have a documented mitigation or acceptance rationale.
rules.check_hint: Flag high/critical risks with no mitigation and no recorded acceptance.

rules.statement: Risks implied by the architecture should appear in the register (e.g. a single-region design should carry an availability risk).
rules.check_hint: Cross-reference architecture findings; flag architectural risks absent from the register.
